author: morphisec
text: GhostAction supply chain: 500+ compromised GitHub accounts, 340+ repos; an active supply chain campaign specifically targeting MCP configs, AI platform tokens, and SSH keys.

author: beincrypto
text: GitBook discloses targeted security breach driven by AI agents: attackers used AI agents to breach its infrastructure credentials, potentially exposing customer API tokens, Git Sync secrets and integration credentials. Rotate secrets.

author: Crypto3cats
text: Chainstack, a node and RPC provider many Web3 devs build on, disclosed a breach via a third-party component; attacker had 5 days inside. Customer names, emails and password hashes may be exposed.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: LLMjacking is becoming a full-scale cybercriminal business: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant investigated incidents where criminals hijacked cloud AI access and resold it through underground subscription services.

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day (CVE-2026-94127) actively exploited: unauthenticated RCE in BIG-IP APM's OAuth, 14,700+ instances exposed, added to CISA KEV.

author: gurvrx
text: Ivanti Connect Secure = ROOT in the wild. 3 chained zero-days, actively exploited by UTA0576: CVE-2026-104935 (unauth RCE 8.6), CVE-2026-111357 (priv-esc to root 8.8, CISA KEV), CVE-2026-118527 (file upload).

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical, partly patched: Node-RED missing adminAuth actively exploited to drop bots and webshells (CVE-2026-58115). Exploited in the wild.

author: morphisec
text: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks, shellcode placed directly into memory: CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, both CVSS 9.5, actively exploited.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell), both CVSS v4.0 9.2, are actively exploited unauthenticated RCE flaws in PHP core. CISA added CVE-2026-109618 to KEV on 26 October 2026.

author: binarly_io
text: New research: Pre-auth RCE in Zyxel GS1900 exploited in the wild as a zero-day, linked to CVE-2026-7273 (KEV); the patch did not stop the exploit.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical zero-click Android RCE patched; CVE-2026-58868. Heap buffer overflow in Android Framework (FrameDecoder.cpp onOutputReceived) allows RCE without user interaction.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Android November 2026 bulletin: critical Framework RCE with no user interaction (CVE-2026-58868), also critical zero-click RCEs CVE-2026-58876 and CVE-2026-58936. Google reports no in-the-wild exploitation.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: WordPress Core (4.7-7.1.3) RCE is KEV-listed and actively exploited. Predictable staging paths during core upgrades let unauthenticated attackers slip in malicious code. CVE-2026-119977.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw (CVE-2026-119977) as actively exploited in attacks.

author: techyoutbe
text: More than 1,000 exposed GitLab instances unpatched against actively exploited CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 RCE fixed in 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN flaw CVE-2026-76418 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker force a reload (DoS) when SSL remote-access VPN is reachable.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SonicWall GMS vulnerability exposes internal files without authentication, CVE-2026-109593.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SolarWinds Dameware command injection flaw, CVE-2026-28336, CVSS 9.9, could allow attackers to compromise remote systems.

author: rst_cloud
text: An operator used the pentestcode AI agent against 25 mid-size and large European companies and reports breaching 10 of them (AI-assisted attack).

author: etugenio
text: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day operator's open directory holds the full in-band root exploit chain, 168 run logs, and a Russian AI-agent memory file, suggesting AI-agent-assisted exploitation.

author: morphisec
text: Carbonato botnet installs the Hermes AI agent on hijacked Docker hosts: worm-like botnet scans for unauthenticated Docker APIs on port 2375 and launches privileged containers.

author: Basant_Pandey
text: Docker Sandboxes CVE-2026-103916 (via Endor Labs): sbx cp followed symlinks, so a prompt-injected AI agent could reach host creds and SSH keys. Upgrade to 0.51.0.

author: joeleboube
text: AI agents browsing with Playwright 1.64.1 still ship Chromium older than Chrome's Oct 27 fix; CVE-2026-118306 can escape the sandbox, and Playwright's sandbox is off by default.

author: loyndsview
text: An Accenture employee's AI agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability patched.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Trojanized Claude Code extension versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 hit Cursor's marketplace on Oct 29, delivering SSH backdoors to developer workstations with no user interaction.

author: morphisec
text: Northflank breach: attackers immediately weaponized stolen AI API keys; OpenAI, Anthropic and other provider credentials abused after the cloud development platform breach.

author: Adellbah
text: Northflank told every customer to assume all their secrets are decrypted after a Wiz threat alert on October 30; rotate secrets.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: OPSSHIELD says unauthorized access to its cPGuard update CDN let an attacker push a malicious script on Nov 2. Check 5.88.12-5.88.19, update to 5.88.25+, reset passwords and rotate DB and cloud keys.

author: Michaelzsguo
text: Binance published an RCA on the October 29 cyberattack ($6.34B stolen): started with a tampered developer tool (Homebrew install of an AI coding tool) and a fake job interview, escalating through compromised laptops and internal AI tooling.

author: keithrull
text: GitBook breached, rotate your tokens.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Google GTIG and Mandiant report LLMjacking incidents driving cloud AI charges above $100,000 per day using exposed endpoints or stolen credentials and API keys to resell access.

author: TonTraderCom
text: At least nine developer platforms targeted in October; attackers used stolen credentials to run $100K of AI services via OpenAI, Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock.

author: OminouslyPie
text: Nikke CDN supply chain attack: gist documents how it works and remediation.

author: num1_ch
text: GitHub reported a vulnerability linked to AI agents, urging users to change their login credentials.
